In square units rounded to the nearest integer, what is the area of $△ABC$ shown above?

In square units rounded to the nearest integer, the area of $△ABC$ is{{field-1}}.
feedback.worked_solution:
In this case, the area of the right triangle is

$$
A=\frac{1}{2}AC\cdot BC.
$$

Notice that relative to the given angle $∠B,$ we have the length of the adjacent side $\overset{―}{BC}$ and need to determine the length of the opposite side $\overset{―}{AC}.$ Hence, we can use the tangent ratio to solve for $AC:$

$$
\begin{aligned}\operatorname{tan}⁡(m∠B) & =\frac{AC}{BC} \\ \operatorname{tan}⁡({28}^{∘}) & =\frac{AC}{14} \\ AC & =14\cdot \operatorname{tan}⁡({28}^{∘}) \\ AC & =7.443…\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, the area of $△ABC$ is

$$
\begin{aligned}A & =\frac{1}{2}\cdot (7.443…)\cdot 14 \\  & =52.107… \\  & ≈52,\end{aligned}
$$

rounded to the nearest integer.
